body_markdown:
The recorded presentation from the Noble Capital Markets Emerging Growth Virtual Equity Conference featuring Nutriband’s Chairman, Serguei Melnik, is now available for viewing.


The session includes a fireside-style Q&A, where Mr. Melnik discusses Nutriband’s ongoing development of AVERSA™ abuse-deterrent transdermal technology and the company’s broader transdermal pharmaceutical pipeline.
